meta.title: Verified after-tax rule set used by the private calculator
meta.purpose: Encodes ONLY rules that were read from an official IRS, California Franchise Tax Board, California BOE, or City of Los Angeles publication. Anything not verified is absent, and the calculator refuses to guess.
meta.verification_note: Every bracket below is traceable to an S-source in data/findings.json. Updated 2026-11-26: removed stale pass-1 unverified MHST artifact (TX-07 was verified and applied via Form 540 Line 62), verified exact IRS Schedule D Tax Worksheet lines 1-47 stacking (S40), and added verified BOE Prop 13 LA County rate (S38), FTB Form 593 withholding (S38), and July 1, 2026 LA City Measure ULA thresholds (S38).

long_term_capital_gain_2026.note: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.03. 0% and 15% ceilings; above the 15% ceiling the rate is 20%.

schedule_d_worksheet.note: IRS Instructions for Schedule D (Form 1040) Schedule D Tax Worksheet lines 1-47: unrecaptured section 1250 gain enters Line 14 (reducing 0% LTCG room and filling ordinary brackets up to the 24% ceiling on Lines 19-21), while remaining 15%/20% LTCG fills Lines 23-34 and excess section 1250 gain is taxed at 25% on Lines 35-40.

federal.like_kind_note: Real property only, held for business or investment; defers rather than eliminates gain. Under Form 6252 / Schedule D instructions, unrecaptured section 1250 gain is recognized before 0%/15%/20% capital gain as principal payments are received.

excluded.reason: Depends on individual QBI thresholds and rental safe-harbor eligibility; not verified for this taxpayer.

excluded.item: Ordinary section 1245/1250 recapture above straight-line depreciation
excluded.reason: Only the 25% unrecaptured section 1250 ceiling is modelled; any accelerated depreciation recapture above straight-line or pre-1981 rules requires owner depreciation schedules.
Thresholds are published (TX-16), but computation requires owner preference items.

excluded.item: California state depreciation conformity differences and Form 3840 out-of-state 1031 tracking
excluded.reason: Depends on historical depreciation method and whether any 1031 replacement property sits outside California.

california.note: 2025 California Tax Rate Schedules, Form 540 (latest published schedules). California has NO preferential long-term capital gains rate: gain is taxed as ordinary income.

standard_deduction_2025.note: FTB 2025 Form 540 instructions, California Standard Deduction Chart for Most People (Line 18).

behavioral_health_services_tax.basis: Taxable income on Form 540 line 19 in excess of $1,000,000 (renamed from Mental Health Services Tax for 2025+).

alternative_minimum_tax.threshold_basis: Total income thresholds triggering California AMT check (Form 540 Line 61).
alternative_minimum_tax.reason_not_applied: Requires Schedule P (540) preference items from the owner's full return.

form_593_withholding_2026.note: FTB 2026 Form 593 closing withholding (prepayment toward final CA income tax, not an additional tax): 3-1/3% of total sales price or optional gain election at maximum applicable rate; installment buyers withhold on principal portions.

measure_ula_effective_2026_07_01.basis: Gross consideration (including liens/encumbrances remaining at sale) for City of Los Angeles conveyances closing after June 30, 2026.

disclaimer: This calculator applies published brackets to numbers YOU supply. It is arithmetic, not tax advice. It deliberately omits unverified or owner-specific preference rules and tells you which ones. Every input stays in this browser tab: no network calls, no analytics, no storage.
